label: 32-bit Montgomery packed sumcheck, direct 2^28
note: Six-layer checker sumcheck (gkr_checker, six 2^28 layer tables padded) with 32-bit subtractive Montgomery (R=2^32) replacing INT64 % in every Triton pass, transcripts bit-identical to reference.py at every k (36 tests). DIRECT 2^28 point: k=3 17.69 ms/layer -> 145.9 ms/batch padded (86.5 unpadded) = 35.6 us/VU vs a-packed's 62.7 (extrapolated) = 1.76x; k=2 19.8 ms, k=4 (unfused 768-row block) 31.0 ms. At 2^26: k=0 12.6 ms (was 31.0: 2.46x), k=3 5.97 ms (was 9.98: 1.67x). 3.35% of INT8 peak; peak memory 18.0 GB at 2^28 k=3. Kernels are SIMT-bound on the limb decomposition + tl.join assembly feeding tl.dot, then HBM.
